tests.description: Validate that backup orchestration delegates snapshot and verification execution to the bounded BackupBackend/Kopia adapter contract and rejects unsupported or unconfigured backend operations without embedding storage-engine behavior in Bahia.
evidence: internal/domain/backup_test.go validates backup run defaults and restore eligibility rules.
internal/service/backup_registry_test.go validates idempotent run creation, reference validation, and verification-first fail-closed completion.

internal/service/backup_run_coordinator_test.go validates fixed-step snapshot/verify orchestration, cancellation recovery state, unsupported verification fail-closed handling, and responder calls without relay polling.
internal/adapters/backup/kopia_backend_test.go validates real Kopia CLI command construction, configuration errors, output parsing, and unsupported first-slice behavior.

tests.description: Inject signed Nostr backup run requests and publish outcomes to verify event-driven backup run processing, publish acceptance checks, rejection summary persistence, dedupe/idempotency, and no sleep-based completion logic.
evidence: internal/controlplane/reactor_backup_requests_test.go validates backup run kind subscription under the default authorized author scope, idempotent durable run creation by requester/kind/d tag, and executor handoff without creating a second run for duplicate coordinates.

internal/controlplane/reactor_backup_requests_test.go validates BackupRunResponder result/status/attestation publication tags, signatures, restore_eligible=false payload, and persisted per-relay publish outcome summaries.

internal/adapters/nostr/protocol_frames_test.go validates PublishResult classification for auth-required, rate-limited, blocked, duplicate, mixed accepted/rejected, duplicate-as-success, and zero-accepted aggregate failure.

Existing reactor Run path continues to use RelayPool.SubscribeAllWithEOSE, ValidateInboundEvent, EventDeduplicator, CLOSED handling, and AUTH retry; backup wiring only adds the 38400 dispatch case and kind to the scoped default filter.

tests.description: Assert that failed, skipped, unsupported, or missing verification is projected as unverified and is not eligible as a verified restore candidate.
evidence: internal/service/backup_registry_test.go validates required verification failure leaves the run failed and BackupRunRestoreEligible false, while non-required verification is skipped and still restore_eligible=false.
internal/service/backup_run_coordinator_test.go validates successful required Kopia verification is the only path that makes BackupRunRestoreEligible true.
internal/adapters/nostr/projector_backup_test.go validates BackupRunState restore_eligible=false for skipped verification and restore_eligible=true only for succeeded verification.

tests.description: Inject restore request and approval/rejection events and verify adapter execution only occurs after required approval, with signed terminal restore result provenance.
evidence: Restore workflows are explicitly outside bahia-dgnt/JW-4/JW-5/JW-6 scope and are tracked separately in Beads before feature-wide completion.

tests.description: Verify scoped subscriptions, EOSE historical catch-up, replay dedupe, CLOSED handling, AUTH-required failure/reauthentication, and partial relay OK outcomes across backup workflow events.
evidence: internal/adapters/nostr/relay_pool_test.go validates merged subscription EOSE, CLOSED reason, and event forwarding behavior.
internal/adapters/nostr/protocol_frames_test.go validates CLOSED/AUTH reason helpers and per-relay publish outcomes used by backup result/attestation publication.

internal/controlplane/reactor_backup_requests_test.go validates the backup run kind is included in scoped default-author filters and backup dispatch remains inside the existing reactor validation/dedup/auth/EOSE path.

tests.description: Validate that the documented backup namespace is internally consistent, avoids known collisions with 31200 and 38395/38396, and includes command/result/read-model/status/attestation tag contracts.
evidence: docs/control-planes.md documents backup commands 38400-38409, terminal results 38410-38419, status/observation kinds 6981-6984, read models 31991-31999, and attestations 31310-31311.
internal/controlplane/backup_kinds.go and internal/adapters/nostr/backup_kinds.go consume the allocated namespace without reusing 31200 or 38395/38396.
Read-model d-tags for implemented mutable backup registries use immutable IDs to avoid stale live coordinates after renames.

tests.description: Run the full Go test suite after wiring reactor, responder, projector, app composition, and PSTF evidence.
evidence: 2026-05-21: go test ./... passed across cmd, internal, pkg, and test/integration packages.

known_gaps: AC-BACKUP-007 restore request/approval/result workflows are outside the first Kopia backup-run slice and are tracked in Beads.
Retention execution, UI flows, Velero, and native snapshot adapters remain outside this slice and require separate Beads issues before feature-wide completion.

implementation_notes: Implemented first-slice request handling consumes BackupRunRequest kind 38400 and publishes BackupRunStatus 6981, BackupRunResult 38410, BackupRunAttestation 31310, and BackupVerificationAttestation 31311 when verification runs.
Kopia is the first production backend slice; Bahia delegates snapshot and verification execution to the real Kopia CLI adapter or explicit configuration/unsupported errors.
No filesystem_mock or fake backup backend is used in production backup paths; deterministic test doubles remain in _test.go files.
BackupRunState restore_eligible is true only when the run succeeded and verification_status is succeeded.
